title: Design System: rayyanabzal.com

fontLoading.method: next/font/local, weights 400 500 600 700, latin and latin-ext subset
fontLoading.fallback: Inter, system-ui, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

motion.reduced-motion: all animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; static page otherwise

breakpoints.640: row label stacks above content; mobile nav and sticky CTA
breakpoints.860: hero, work and offers grids stack
breakpoints.1100: work legend becomes a wrapped row

focus.value: 2px solid var(--focus), offset 2px, radius 6px; green gold on dark bands

narrative.northStar: A Quiet Room with One Loud Sentence
narrative.overview: Zero-chroma neutrals in light and dark by prefers-color-scheme. One green hue (150) for live and selected, blue (250) only for focus. Home shows the work moving: a teardown hero, an exploded three-plate stack of client builds, and living offer scenes. Inner pages stay calm.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-chroma ground, surface and sunken steps with three inks
Hairline edges; soft two-layer shadow on drawn product only
Ink-filled buttons, 10px radius, 40px tall, press scale 0.97
Open Runde at 400 to 700, tabular numerals for drawn data
Feature panels stay dark in both schemes
rules: The Two Hues Rule: green means live or selected, blue means focus, nothing else
The Ink Fill Rule: solid controls are ink and flip with the scheme
The Panel Text Rule: on dark panels use on-panel or cream, never grey ink tokens
The No Kicker Rule: no eyebrow, kicker or overline
The Data Face Rule: drawn product uses the body face with tabular numerals
The Soft Shadow Rule: large blur, negative spread, no hard offsets
The Hairline Rule: edges are 1px line or line-2
dos: Use tokens and let the dark block do the theming
Keep ink-3 at or above 0.53 (light) and 0.66 (dark) lightness
Disclose that product visuals are drawn with synthetic data
donts: Reintroduce pine green, yellow gold or warm stone values
Add a hue beyond green 150 and blue 250
Put grey ink on a dark panel
Use monospace, a second typeface or client screenshots
Add hard offset shadows or borders heavier than 1px

notCanonized: home.css .sec-head h2 uppercase tracked label (kicker-style; home rows use a sentence-case row label instead)
--font-mono mapped to the body face in @theme inline for shadcn only
--pine-rgb leftover from the old green world
Legacy aliases pine, pine-2, pine-tint, gold, gold-2, sage, well kept for compatibility only
